quarterly_data.signal: FY to March 2026 (orders, revenue, business profit and pre-tax profit exclude Mitsubishi Logisnext and its subsidiaries/affiliates, classified as discontinued operations): orders received JPY 7,653,637 million (+19.5%), revenue JPY 4,974,168 million (+14.1%), business profit JPY 432,218 million (+21.8%), profit before income taxes JPY 474,694 million (+34.8%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 332,129 million (+35.3%). quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments (FY to March 2026): Plants & Infrastructure orders received JPY 1,158,062 million (+15.8%) on a large fertilizer plant order and a CO2 capture plant order in the UK, revenue JPY 880,893 million (+3.4%), business profit JPY 84,106 million (+41.0%). quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex (FY to March 2026) JPY 178,367 million (+23.2%): Energy JPY 54,085 million (+10.7%), mainly expanding GTCC-related facilities; Aircraft, Defense & Space JPY 70,957 million (+87.1%), mainly missile-related facilities. Capex plan for the following year JPY 200,000 million: Energy JPY 87,000 million (GTCC-related facilities and others), Aircraft, Defense & Space JPY 45,000 million (defense aircraft-related), Plants & Infrastructure JPY 33,000 million, Logistics, Thermal & Drive Systems JPY 24,000 million, Other JPY 3,000 million, corporate JPY 8,000 million (R&D-related); the company expects production capacity to increase slightly versus the start of the works. Management states it will execute the many orders won on strong demand in energy (GTCC, nuclear) and defense steadily and on time, and will raise production capacity with an efficient, lean setup, including optimizing the GTCC production process
quarterly_data.figure: capex plan JPY 200,000 million, of which Energy JPY 87,000 million; FY capex JPY 178,367 million (+23.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states the data center market is growing with generative AI and IoT, while tight supply of equipment such as power, cooling and power distribution is a challenge; the group will modularize these systems, supply optimized utilities and provide equipment maintenance and services to make data center operation both efficient and stable, and will develop products for distributed digital infrastructure as customers increasingly need high-security environments. The Data Center & Energy Management business is reported in 'Other', outside the reportable segments. In the energy transition the group is developing CO2 capture and Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) systems for next-generation geothermal power

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D expense (FY to March 2026) JPY 289,078 million, including JPY 208,911 million of contracted research. Energy JPY 55,716 million: next-generation high-efficiency, high-reliability GTCC; an integrated demonstration from next-generation hydrogen production (water electrolysis, SOEC high-temperature steam electrolysis, methane pyrolysis) to power generation with hydrogen gas turbines; ammonia-fired gas turbines and 100% ammonia burners; the advanced light-water reactor SRZ-1200 plus high-temperature gas-cooled, fast, small and micro reactors. Logistics, Thermal & Drive Systems JPY 8,783 million: hydrogen co-firing and 100% hydrogen engines for the distributed generator market; large-capacity, high-efficiency centrifugal (turbo) chillers using low-environmental-impact refrigerant, meeting overseas standards, for data centers and semiconductor plants. Other JPY 1,932 million: utility systems for data centers and next-generation power supply and cooling technology. Aircraft, Defense & Space JPY 185,418 million
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expense JPY 289,078 million; Energy JPY 55,716 million
